question: Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was a prominent singer of the ______ gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is **Patiala**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan

__
 
• Indian Hindustani classical vocalist, from the Patiala Gharana.
 
• Patiala Gharana was founded in the mid to late 19th century by his great-grandfather Mian Kallu.
 
• His pen name: Sabrang
 
• He was awarded by
 
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1962)
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi fellow (1967)
 
• Padma Bhushan Award (1962)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**** Rampur Sahaswan:**

 
• Ustad Rashid Khan is an Indian classical musician in the Hindustani music tradition.
 
• He belongs to the **Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana.**
 
• Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan was an Indian classical musician in the Hindustani classical music tradition, belonging to the **Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana.**
 
• **Ustad Inayat Hussain Khan (1849–1919)** was an Indian classical vocalist and the founder of Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana.

The Bhendi Bazaar Gharana was founded around 1890 by brothers Chhajju Khan, Nazir Khan, and Khadim Hussain Khan in the Bhendi bazaar area of Mumbai
